microcap.unit: NAV; first published observation retained without rebasing

caveat.en: Only the 400-name published NAV is available here. A rule reconstruction, not an official index or executable account: no costs, limit handling or calibrated capacity. Its 2015-onward period differs from the early risk summaries.
caveat.zh: 这里只提供已有的400只净值。它是规则重建，不是官方指数或可成交账户，未计成本、涨跌停处理及校准容量。2015年后的曲线与早期风险汇总区间不同。

summaryCaveat.en: 2008–2014 only. Longest underwater is completed episodes in trading sessions; each count has one right-censored episode. Unknown classified prices are held flat. Historical ST and suspension fields are incomplete. No NAV curves for these five counts are supplied.
summaryCaveat.zh: 仅限2008—2014年。最长水下期按已恢复区间的交易日统计，各股票数均有一个右删失区间。已分类的未知价格按前值持平。历史ST与停牌字段不完整。未提供这五组数量的净值曲线。

caveat.en: USD median of lagged 20-session mean traded value. Historical buckets pool security-days; observations differ from unique stocks. Common dates do not equal common universes. A-share covers Shanghai/Shenzhen only; JP historical shares are incomplete and exploratory. 2026 lacks US and ends in April on common support. Not order-book depth, execution cost or capacity.
caveat.zh: 美元计价的滞后20日平均成交额之中位数。历史分组汇集证券日，观测数不同于股票数。共同日期不等于共同股票池。A股仅沪深；日股历史股数不完整，属探索比较。2026年不含美股，共同日期止于四月。该指标不是盘口深度、执行成本或容量。
